title: Корпус: склад і версії
fields_and_relations: Критерії, group/reason, ordered exact target revisions, access snapshot.
required_interaction: Freeze/new version; відкликаний елемент лишає дозволене посилання, не старі bytes.

implementation.view_model: Exact source/text/media/layer/segment targets with source and optional layer anchors, independent group/reason/order, selection context, immutable history, freeze, redacted unavailable items and exact source handoff
limitations: Shared editing/server ACL are outside the local prototype. Range/segment annotation and exact source reading are provided by WF-17; multiple evidence analysis remains WF-18 and corpus byte export remains WF-19.
implementation.state_storage: Shared normalized browser store v9; existing data and historical source-only corpora preserved
permissions: research.write in an explicit archive grant
domain.read rechecked for every source, note, assertion, citation and download
implementation.atomicity: Authorize, compare expected corpus/assertion revision, mutate clone, validate exact FK/versions and immutable corpus membership hashes, commit once.
